coverage.scope: Two originating product keys, current Singapore shade listing, same-product counterexamples, Korean-brand satin cushion and US matte liquid foundation. No worldwide market census.

limitations: This is agent-mediated research, not independent semantic labels or measured product performance.
Different mixing motives do not prove a common specific unmet color/coverage/glow combination.
Source product keys establish listing identity; participant variant/SKU and generation are unresolved.
Brand claims and other users cannot establish suitability for either participant.
Catalogue absence, unknown stock, INCI and unspecified shades are not evidence of worldwide absence or a formulation gap.
Counterevidence retains known source coordinates without copying names, demographics or raw author identifiers.

decision.reason: The two mixing reports have different motivations and unspecified target options. Existing shade choices and satisfactory standalone reports weaken a broad absence claim, but do not prove either participant has a satisfactory substitute. A shared specific new-product requirement is unestablished.
decision.falsifier: Reopen this lead if attributable repeated users document the same target shade/finish and wear condition, actual alternative trials, and a common residual failure rather than different mixing motives.
